_comment: Provenance for the vendored block-palette dumps this directory holds. Each entry names the exact upstream release the file was pulled from, byte-for-byte, so the chain back to the game stays auditable (architecture decision 12). Re-pin by re-running the fetch against the named tag and checking the sha256 still matches what upstream serves -- a mismatch means the tag was force-moved upstream, which is worth investigating rather than silently accepting.

entries.note: Earliest tag that carries metadata/vanilladata_modules at all -- see COVERAGE.md.
Byte-identical to v1.26.0.2's dump -- no block-palette change shipped between them despite the version-number jump.
Byte-identical to v1.21.130.3's dump -- see above.
Latest stable tag as of the pin date below; byte-identical to the repository's main branch at the same date.

coverage_note: This is a representative subset of the stable (non -preview) tags that carry the dump, not the full ladder. bedrock-samples has published the dump on every stable tag from v1.20.10.1 through the current release (26 stable tags as surveyed on the pin date); adding the rest is a matter of extending this manifest with the same fields and re-running `cargo xtask generate-palette` -- the generator does not special-case which versions are present.
